cells.raw_text: Patient presents to local hospital with pyrexia and chest pain
Severe LV dysfunction not improving with inotropic infusions
Impella 5 inserted via left subclavian artery
Cardiac index 3.2 L/min/m^(2), CVP 8, and PCWP 13
CT showing worsening ground-glass opacification of both lungs
Nursed in the prone position to improve hypoxaemia
